text: Lorewalking: The Elves of Quel'thalas is an expansion feature achievement earned by completing the "Elves" lorewalking campaign. It rewards the Tome of Silvermoon Intrigue housing decor.
Lost Legion Infernals are infernals that appear throughout the Broken Isles during the final phase of WoW Remix: Legion. They are similar to world bosses in strength.

Lost Idol of the Hash'ey drops from rare mobs in Zul'Aman and from various world quests in . Its proc effect triggers one of the following buffs, representing Nalorakk, Halazzi, and Kulzi respectively, accompanied by a visual of the loa in question briefly appearing atop the player character. * * *
Lost Star is looted from Nemesis Strongbox and Bountiful Heavy Trunk at the end of Delves.

Loyalist Secretions drop from Loyalist Bio-smiths and Loyalist Mutagenicians in the Transformatory of the City of Threads. Y'tekhi is looking for six vials in Lab Access.

The Lovingly Handcrafted Clue is found in Karazhan Catacombs during the Ratts' Revenge scenario. It is located atop a shelf with a Sealed Clue in it. With the "incomplete" or "unsolvable" bit from Ratts' Journal, Pages 92-93 nearby, players added the word RATTS to the anagram to solve the anagram as "OLGRA SEEKS THE LIGHT IN MIND, BODY, AND SOUL." Solving this massive anagram is also an impossible ask (it's huge), so the intent is that puzzle solvers were always going to "cheat", proving Ratts' point. The Chinese localizers did not remove "Ratts", which shortcut the solution. This is the intended pointer to find Olgra's three locations across the Warcraft universe for the 1 o'clock orb for I
Loyal Attendants are nerubian sages located at the High Hollows in the City of Threads.

Lub and Plunder is an account-wide feat of strength for acquiring 2,500 Plunder in Plunderstorm matches. The total amount collected is visible on the Plunderstorm character select screen, and during matches in the menu in the upper right. On retail realms, the tracking macro below will link the achievement and display the current total: /run local c,_,_,_,a,b=BreakUpLargeNumbers,GetAchievementCriteriaInfo(20509,1) print(GetAchievementLink(20509),c(a),"of",c(b),C_CurrencyInfo.GetCurrencyLink(2922))

Loyal Stoneborn are stoneborn found in the Halls of Atonement dungeon. Players of the Venthyr Covenant can charm these using an Extra Action Button, causing them to fight with the party. They will then fly off after 45 seconds.

The Lunar Chest can be found in and . It contains the Rune of the Sun for druids. To make the chest appear, to go either in southern Teldrassil or in southern Mulgore. Cast Moonfire on each of the three Lunar Stones at those locations, and the Lunar Chest will appear within the circle of flowers on the ground.
Three Lunar Stones can be found at either in southern or in southern . Casting Moonfire on each of the three stones will cause the Lunar Chest will appear within the circle of flowers on the ground.
Lunar Festival Revelers are tauren located in Moonglade during Lunar Festival.
Lukou's Mask of Regeneration is an appearance unlocked through the use of Ensemble: Heritage of the Darkspear.
Luminescent Umbrashrooms are located in the Burrows in the City of Threads.
Lucky Cursed Potion is a delve power that was found during the delves.
Lunar Eclipse is a Balance druid ability granted by the Eclipse talent. Casting Wrath will cause it to change to Solar Eclipse.
Luminescent Wards are located around in Dawnstar Village on the Isle of Quel'Danas during the assault by the Devouring Host.
Lumberjack Warlord is a housing achievement earned by harvesting 250 Shadowmoon Lumber.

Lucky Keychain is an optional crafting reagent used to remove embellishments when recrafting in . It is created with Midnight Engineering, discovered through the Recycling ability. Using a piece of gear with the extra sparkle will always cause a player character to do their special flip animation, if they have one.
Luvkip is fished from Curious Swirling Pools in Southfury River in the Northern Barrens and Olivia's Pond in Stormwind City during Love is in the Air.
Lynndy Leatherbolts is a goblin located upstairs in the Incontinental Hotel during the Liberation of Undermine. She serves as a Crafting Orders coordinator.

Lurking Defiler's Scalemail is the Ny'alotha, the Waking City set for mail-wearers. Several items for each armor slot can count towards collecting the appearance. Some drops from Grand Empress Shek'zara and Vuk'laz the Earthbreaker and a few pieces that can be crafted with Battle for Azeroth Leatherworking can unlock the normal difficulty appearance. Completing the set grants the All Eyes On Me achievement.
Lush Garden Butterfly Sconce is housing decor that can be purchased from the Battle.net Shop for 100 Hearthsteel. It is also available in the limited time Lush Garden Decor Pack.
Mace of Amaranthine Power drops from: *Gaur *Lady Fleshsear *Mage Lord Gogg'nathog *Teluur *Annihilon *Commander Dro'gan

MC Farala is a human quest giver during Hearthstone's 10th Anniversary. She is found in: *the Seat of the Aspects in Valdrakken *Stormwind Harbor in Stormwind City *the Dranosh'ar Blockade in Durotar She sends a Hearthstone Invitation Letter.

Ma'nussa was a city-state upon K'aresh, which was under the rulership of Ky'veza during the Devouring War. It was described as an ancient resting place along the roads frequently traveled by the nomads, and as being the same size as the expansive markets of Tazavesh. Pre-Manussa civilization is one of the periods of K'areshi history.
M3DDY, Travel-Sized is an exclusive Engineering optional crafting reagent that is made with Midnight Engineering, discovered through the Recycling ability.
Magic Nibbler is a quest reward from A Collection of Creatures. If it is now chosen, it is then sold by Groundskeeper Kama and Unatos in Valdrakken for .
Magic Pumpkin Seeds drop from Defias Brotherhood mobs in . They can be used at any farm, along with Fishy Bonemeal and Fertile Soil Sample, to spawn an Aggressive Squashling.
The Magical Bloom is a plant found at the Shoreline Roots in the Emerald Dream.

Magic-Lined Manifold is found in the Unclaimed Auction House Crate by the entrance to Auction House at in Trade District of the Vision of Stormwind during Horrific Visions Revisited. It is a part for the Deathcycle Exhaust System, required to make the Felreaver Deathcycle.
Magical Mulch is created by Herbalists with Khaz Algar Herbalism.
Magical Snow Sled is sold by Murik and Kiopo in the Azure Span for .

The Magical Treasure Chest is located on the isle in the bay of the southwestern Isle of Dorn. It is left behind by Lionel after helping him back into the water and feeding him five Plump Snapcrab (item).

Mai'zin is a jungle troll found at the Gurubashi Arena in . He sells rewards for the Blood Moon event.
Malek'ta is a rare cosmic worm that can be found near a destroyed caravan south-east of Eco-Dome: Primus on K'aresh.
Malevolent Gladiator: Season 12 (3v3) is a feat of strength earned for ending PvP Season 12 in the top 0.1% of the 3v3 arena ladder with at least 50 games won.

Equipping this weapon rewards the Mal'vorus, Shard of the Defiler (achievement) feat of strength. Manaforged Instrument is a crafting reagent for Khaz Algar enchanters and Khaz Algar scribes. The three deals from scribes are used to unlock the Xy Trustee's Gearglider and flying mount and Cartel Transmorpher toy. The instrument is a quest reward from the one-time quest Head Hunting: Forgeweaver Araz, which unlocks after reaching Renown 8 with the Manaforge Vandals faction. It also drops from Forgeweaver Araz after the quest is completed.

Mantle of Stars is a curio for Valeera Sanguinar during Midnight Season 1. The baseline version is found in low-tier delves, and higher-rank versions are found in higher-tier delves, all the way up to the Rank 4 version in Tier 8 delves.

Marja Lenglow is an Arathi located in Mereldar in Hallowfall. She plays Light's Gambit with Faerin Lothar. When Faerin was showing the game to Anduin Wrynn, Marja was asked to lend Faerin some spare game pieces. When Hallowfall once again came under threat by the Sureki and the army was stretched thin, a call to arms was issued to those with the strength to wield a weapon. Marja answered the call, joining the Flame's Radiance. She was stationed at Lothar's Landing, where she could be seen healing wounded soldiers. Marja was among the forces of the Vanguard of the Light fighting against the Devouring Host at the Sunwell Ramparts on the Isle of Quel'Danas.

Mark of the Spelunker Supreme is rewarded from The War Within Season 1: Spelunker Supreme. Trade it to Ab'xal or Ip'xal at just outside the Cobwebs inn in the Burrows of City of Threads in Azj-Kahet for Heroic tier, or Normal tier with a PvP ilvl bonus.

Mark of the Nightwing Raven teaches the Nightwing Raven barbershop customization for Travel Form. Unlike most marks, this isn't an obtainable item, but rather a spell cast by to teach the form. If a druid speaks Celestine in Stormwind City or Gilneas while she's in human form (e.g. during the day), she'll offer the dialogue option " While Horde druids cannot speak to Celestine, the Nightwing Raven form becomes available to them if learned by an Alliance druid in the same warband. An easy way for Horde players to obtain it is to make a new worgen druid, complete the quests up to and including Time to Regroup, and find Celestine in Greymane Court.

Master of Puppets is a powerful Klaxxi Augmentation that allows mind-controlling a mob in the Dread Wastes, causing it to act as a guardian pet for up to 10 minutes. It is granted by Kaz'tik the Manipulator at Klaxxi'vess. Like all Klaxxi buffs, it remains on the adventurer indefinitely while in the zone, including upon re-entry, but is replaced if a different Augmentation is selected.
Mastery: Monster Within is the Devourer demon hunter mastery ability.
Master the Darkness is the apex talent for Discipline priests. It grants the Void Shield ability when active.
Master of Warfare is the apex talent for Arms warriors. It grants the Heroic Strike ability when active.
Mattimeo Twinstar is an Arathi vendor located in Wildcamp Or'lay in Azj-Kahet.
Mawhorses are a type of incorporeal horse found in the Maw. Only the Jailer's most powerful lieutenants are gifted these steeds to stalk the halls of Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Mawsworn Skylurkers are Mawsworn kyrian found flying above the bridge just southwest of the Tremaculum in the Maw during a Venthyr Assault. They are getting attacked by Vorkai Trappers. Players need to use Korayn's Spear to bring them to the ground.
Mawsworn Painspikes are Maw casters found at the Seeker's Quorum in Korthia during Strength to Weakness.
Meaty Turtle Haunches drop from Chillwater Turtles at the Lake of Stars in the Dread Wastes.
Meat and Potatoes is a food item made with Khaz Algar Cooking (35). The ability to make this food can be learned from the three cooking trainers on Khaz Algar: Athodas, Treagor, and Sauciere Drook.

, a mechanical frog companion.]] Mechanical frogs are frog-like robots created by engineers or real frogs that were turned into robots. Many of the frogs on Mechagon Island were mechanized as a result of King Mechagon's experiments. Mechanical frogs can hop over seven million times before their gears begin to wear out. They have evolved to eat various mechanical insects, somehow. Certain mechanical frogs can be used for spying purposes. Some mechanical frogs can also be found in Undermine. Talented engineers have crafted an exact replica of a Wood Frog, at only ten times the cost of buying the real thing.
Maxwell Stables Saddle is housing decor purchased from "Den" Nightshade in Razorwind Shores and Fel'orei Moonstrider in Founder's Point for .
__NOTOC__ Melikree was a jungle troll located by the Zen'shiri Trading Post in the Valley of Strength in Orgrimmar during November 2023.
Mei Steadypaw is a pandaren located in the Shrine of Seven Stars.
Meesk the Venomtongue is an ascended nerubian located in the City of Threads.

Meesk's Retreat is a building belonging to Meesk the Venomtongue, located in the High Hollows at the eastern end of the City of Threads in Azj-Kahet. It hangs just beside the House of the Fangs. Inside are various storage containers, cages both empty and occupied, some old miscellany such as a Dingy Shadecaster, and a few incriminating items. When Meesk kidnapped Spindle, one of Widow Arak'nai's young spies, he kept her locked in one of the cages here.
Mega Jolt is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
Mega Discharge is an ability used by a pet during a Pet Battle.
Memo from Apothecary Hummel is sniffed out by O.D.I.E. in the Valley of Honor in Orgrimmar and in the Canals and the Dwarven District in Stormwind City.
Membrane of Dark Neurosis is crafted by Leatherworking (250); learned from speaking with the Shadowy Figure in Moonglade after completing Waking the Nightmare.
Members Only is offered by Paula Piranha in the Incontinental Hotel the first time players zone in to the Liberation of Undermine. It unlocks the Gallagio Loyalty Rewards Club renown track.
Memento of Epoch Power drops from Cache of Infinite Treasure or by scrapping gear via Unraveling Sands during Legion Remix. It is automatically consumed once obtained.
Memorial Plaque is found in Thalassian Pass in Eversong Woods. First-time interaction awards 250 reputation with the Silvermoon Court.

Merciless Gladiator: Season 2 is a feat of strength earned for ending PvP Season 2 in the top 0.1% of the arena ladder with at least 50 games won. The achievement is automatically earned by those that had obtained the :Merciless Gladiator title during Season 2. The title is also rewarded by the achievement for those that do qualify but happened to have lost the title.

Mentor's Helpful Handiwork is a finishing crafting reagent that increases crafting skill by 20 while crafting most items from any Midnight profession. It can be obtained by fulfilling Crafting Orders, opening an Artisan's Consortium Payout, or by combining 5 Artisan's Ledger. 5 of them can be combined to form an Artisan's Consortium Gold Star.
The Midnight Darkmoon Charger is a horse mount. It's tagged as a Trading Post item but hasn't yet been made available. <!--
Mickey Junkfeast is a goblin located in the Incontinental Hotel in the Liberation of Undermine.
Meticulous Experimentation is a discovery ability from Khaz Algar Alchemy. It consumes 10 of any one type of herb and has a 20 hour cooldown. It is discovered through Wild Experimentation.
Metamorphosis: Immolation Aura is a passive Demonology warlock ability.
Midnight: Journey's End (Season 1) is a feat of strength earned for completing the Delver's Journey during Midnight Season 1.
Midnight Delves: Tier 10 (Season 1) is a feat of strength earned by completing a Tier 10 delve with lives remaining.
Midnight Delves: Tier 11 (Season 1) is a feat of strength earned by completing a Tier 11 delve with lives remaining.
Might of the Black Dragonflight is a Scalecommander evoker hero talent.
Milgrit Stonefeather is an earthen flight master located at Shadowvein Point in the Ringing Deeps.

The Might of Stormwind is a world buff applied after someone delivered End of the Dark Horde, the quest to kill Rend Blackhand. It increased Health by 300, Mana Regeneration by 10 and Melee Haste Rating by 150.

Mildewed Celebration Crate is found at in the open-world Dire Maul in Feralas during Guest Relations. The crate is only visible while buffed with the Potion of Truth made available on 13 November, found at atop Thunder Peak in Ashenvale. The buff lasts 30 minutes, and will be lost by teleporting, hearthing, or otherwise leaving Kalimdor via any means. The crate begins Mildewed Celebration Crate (quest), which rewards 5x Bronze Celebration Token and is required for Crate Insurance Agent and No Crate Left Behind. This crate was found early on 1 November, but in an uninteractable state. The Mildewed Ransom Note was hotfixed in a few hours after daily reset on the 13th, after the Potion of Truth

Mine Poppin is an exploration achievement earned by destroying a combination of 500 Nerubian Silk Balloon Mines and Nerubian Hanging Mines in Azj-Kahet.

Mindi Maxlof is a goblin located in Pillarstone Spire in the Ringing Deeps. Her boss sent her to Gundargaz to pass out a stack of flyers to Opportunity Point, but her trike broke down, so she started repairing it.

Mind-Seeker is a feat of strength awarded to players who have solved at least 17 past secrets and then found Anakron in the alternate Seat of Knowledge in the Vale of Eternal Blossoms. Though not listed in-game, earning the feat awards the title . This secret was first identified by a user of the WoW Secret Finding Discord on 30 January 2026, 10 days after the launch of patch 12.0.0.
Mind Crush is an ability card from the War of the Ancients set.
Mirigosa was one of the blue drakes that Talinstrasz believed had been stolen from primal nests as an egg and infused with Order magic.
Mintine the Tireless is a niffen mining trainer located in the Umbral Bazaar in the City of Threads in Azj-Kahet.
The Misprinted Card is looted from the Trick Deck of Cards on the desk next to Paks Topskimmer in the Incontinental Hotel in the Undermine.
Mirveda's Notes is a scroll written by Apprentice Mirveda found at the Path of Dawn in Eversong Woods. First-time interaction awards 250 reputation with the Silvermoon Court.
Mirehunter Hatchlings are small saurolisks that spawn when Hatching Mirehunter Eggs are destroyed just west of Zalamar in Nazmir.
Mischievous Floods are pandaren spirits found in Island Expeditions.

The Mistwalker is a feat of strength earned by clearing all Challenge Mode dungeons within the specified time limit during Challenge Mode Season 2. It is granted at the end of the season rather than immediately upon clearing all times.
Mitiis is a draenei located in Olivia's Pond in Stormwind City during Love is in the Air event. She helps adventurers relax during the quest The Gift of Relaxation (Alliance).

Mmarl is a niffen settlement found in Azj-Kahet. Mmarl has been around for a long time, longer than Loamm. The niffen there have managed to set up trade with the nerubians of Azj-Kahet and some of them are even able to trade in the City of Threads. In the past, the nerubians tried to forcibly "conscript" the Mmarl niffen to work for them in Rak-Ush, but they failed and now the nerubians are banned from the town. In recent times the niffen came into contact with a group of Venture Company goblins, led by Jenni Boombuckle, who excavated their way into Azj-Kahet and set up camp at the edge of Mmarl. Mix'ni is a nerubian located in the Umbral Bazaar in the City of Threads.

The Mogu Hazeblazer is a flying disc mount that can be purchased for 2,200 Bronze (Pandaria Remix) from the following vendors during Pandaria Remix: *Horos at the Timeless Shore on the Timeless Isle *Hemet Nesingwary XVII at Infinite Bazaar locations across Pandaria
The Molten Frontaur is a tauren located in Stormwind City and Orgrimmar.
The Molten Engine spawns after defeating the Stolen Loader Strange Disturbance. Interacting with it will always provide the Loader Signal delve power.
Moldy Chests are found during delves. They contain a random delve power for the season.
Moderate Mechanization is a neighborhood endeavor involving the mechagnomes of Mechagon Island.
